08/21.07.2023  Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chandrapura (C.T.P.S.) Case No. 120/2021, corresponding to G.R. No.1034/2021, for the offences registered under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Bermo at Tenughat.

entities.text: Court of learned S.D.J.M., Bermo at Tenughat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is alleged that petitioner was the agent of the informant.
He had lifted coal at the instance of the informant from C.C.L., but he did not pay Rs.11,17,046/-, which was due to the informant.
Mr. Rajesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that petitioner has already paid Rs.3,00,000/- in the Lok Adalat.
He is ready to pay Rs.3,17,046/-, which is due to the informant.
It was submitted that rest amount of Rs.5,00,000/- were to be given by one Sushil Kumar Singh, on whom informant has instituted a complaint case being C.P. Case No.387/2021.

Mr. Krishna Murari, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant submitted that the informant has no objection, if amount of Rs.3,17,046/- is paid to him subject to the final disposal of this case.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for Anticipatory Bail.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within three weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Bermo at Tenughat in connection with Chandrapura (C.T.P.S.)
Case No. 120/2021, corresponding to G.R. No.1034/2021, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
The petitioner at the time of furnishing bail bond shall deposit Bank draft of Rs.3,17,046/- in the name of the informant.
Learned Court below shall hand over the Bank draft to the informant after due verification and proper identification.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
